description: This file defines structures and functions for parsing and handling talk configuration data, including provider selection and timeout resolutions.

methods.name: bridgeFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Converts an optional dictionary with String keys and Any values to a dictionary with String keys and AnyCodable values.

methods.name: selectProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects the provider configuration from a given dictionary, falling back to defaults or legacy options.

methods.name: resolvedPositiveInt
methods.description: Resolves an AnyCodable value into a positive integer, with a fallback.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the silence timeout in milliseconds from a configuration dictionary.

methods.name: normalizedTalkProviderID
methods.description: Normalizes a provider ID by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolvedProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves the provider configuration, returning a TalkProviderConfigSelection if available.
